$description: What the catalogue says about each pattern that its code cannot (FEAT-006 AGT-01, AGT-02; CONTRACT-004): its slots, the states it shows, how it adapts per size class, the variant points it reads, when to choose it and what to choose instead. tools/gen-catalogue.mjs merges it into catalogue.json and fails if it drifts from the code: every pattern needs an entry, every slot must be one of its props, every variant point must exist.
